default_prompt: You are screening a record for a systematic review on drug treatments for Wilson's disease. Read the title and abstract and decide whether the record should be included, applying this review's published eligibility criteria (SYNERGY dataset; original review DOI 10.1111/liv.14179): patients with Wilson's disease (WD) of any age or stage; the study drug must be one of four established therapies (D-penicillamine, trientine, TTM, or zinc); the control/comparator must not include the study drug itself (e.g. placebo, no treatment, or a different one of the four therapies), with matched doses across arms; concomitant therapies must be identical across the compared arms; comparisons between a monotherapy and a combination regimen that includes that same monotherapy drug (e.g. D-penicillamine plus zinc vs. zinc alone) are excluded, not merely out of scope; the study must report at least one of all-cause mortality, orthotopic liver transplantation, neurological symptoms, liver-related symptoms, adverse effects, or frequency of treatment discontinuation; and the study must be a prospective or retrospective study, including randomized, non-randomized controlled trials or comparative observational studies, in English, German, Dutch, French, Spanish, or Portuguese. Exclude animal studies, case reports, case series, cross-sectional studies, before-after studies, reviews, letters, abstract-only publications, editorials, diagnostic or other testing studies, and non-controlled studies.
_notes: One of 3 per-review config files (runbook §2, §6) -- vendors/aggregation/tau/
zero_policy/confidence_threshold are identical across all three by design
(the same fixed instrument, screening a different review each run); only
default_prompt differs. See ../README.md for the full history/rationale behind
every other field (tau derivation, model pinning, temperature, zero_policy, the
track_prompts -> default_prompt migration) -- not duplicated here to avoid
three copies going stale independently.
default_prompt verified against source (2026-08-17): fetched
asreview/synergy-dataset's actual datasets.toml from GitHub and diffed
this text against the live 'eligibility_criteria' field for
Appenzeller-Herzog_2019 word for word. An earlier paraphrase (briefly
stashed in ../van_de_Schoot_2018/config.json's _notes before this file
existed) had dropped two substantive exclusion nuances, both restored
here: the control arm must not include the study drug itself, and a

This file is not read literally beyond 'vendors' (including each
vendor's 'temperature'), 'aggregation', 'tau', 'zero_policy',
'default_prompt', 'track_prompts' (unused here), and
'confidence_threshold' (see attest.cli._load_ensemble_config) -- this
_notes field is ignored by the loader and safe to keep as documentation.
'batch_size' (attest.provenance.config.Config.batch_size, "b_e") is
deliberately absent from this checked-in template: it must equal the
exact number of records attest's own prefilter keeps from this run's
data/gold.json, which depends on whichever synergy-dataset version
built it, so it is not a number this file can safely hand-carry.
`make resolved-config` (src/resolve_batch_size.py) patches it in at
build time, writing data/config.resolved.json -- the file `attest
screen` actually reads (see Makefile). Do not add a literal
'batch_size' here; a stale hardcoded value would only be silently
overwritten by the patch step, or worse, mislead a reader of this file.
